chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey: Chapter 345 - Han Li's Desperate Flight from the Mantis
chapter_meta_description: Han Li's prized White Phosphorus Shield is shattered. He is forced into a desperate aerial chase with an impossibly fast giant mantis. Can he escape this super-predators onslaught?
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey - Chapter 345: Hard-Pressed
og_description: His shield is gone, his tools are being shredded, and the monster is faster than his flying boat. Han Li is in big trouble.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch.345: When Escape Is the Only Option
twitter_description: The giant mantis is faster, stronger, and smarter than expected. Han Li learns a hard lesson about the apex predators of this world.

lore_anchors.definition: A speed-focused flying artifact; capable of great speed, but Han Li is finding it outstripped for the first time.
A top-grade defensive tool made from Ink Flood Dragon scales; its destruction marks a major loss for Han Li.
A trophy obtained from the white spider arc that can completely conceal a cultivator’s aura and spiritual energy fluctuations.
A cultivator’s most vital life force, lost permanently upon use, causing irreversible damage to lifespan and cultivation base.
A solidified, high-speed projectile technique; a powerful but finite trump card for Han Li.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the 'Blood Essence Diamond' Han Li is holding?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a solidified, high-speed projectile technique that he uses as a last-resort trump card. It is incredibly fast and powerful but linked to his own Essence Blood, making it a costly and finite resource.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Han Li just fight the mantis head-on?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because it's vastly more powerful than him. It cut through his best shield in one hit, is as fast as his flying boat, and has the intelligence to actively hunt him. Fighting it would be suicide.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Spirit-Reveiling Gauze a sure thing?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not at all. It masks his aura, but it relies on the mantis having limited intelligence and patience. The chapter ends with the mantis still searching, leaving Han Li's safety completely unresolved.
